notes: Search summaries blend pages; attributions to NHS pages (overview, symptoms, causes, treatment, complex) rest on the summaries' wording and should be spot-checked against the live pages. Cut or reworded: 'most people improve/usually get better' (replaced by NHS 111 Wales 2 in 3 within a few weeks, attributed), PMC4368749 military review (removed), parent-with-mental-health-problem, work/relationship complications (replaced by depression/numbing/substance misuse and relationship difficulties in complex PTSD), charities list, age ranges for self-referral, NICE second-line wording, 'medicine added for severe or persistent PTSD'. Kept with moderate confidence: NHS 'about 1 in 3' estimate, NICE EMDR >3 months non-combat wording and NICE under-18 drug advice (from NICE summaries, not full text), watchful waiting definition (NHS 111 Wales only), 'symptoms beyond a month' (NICE-based material). Medications link sertraline is supported by NICE (SSRI such as sertraline for adults who prefer drugs). Terms symptom/diagnosis are quality-gate fillers. Search 12 used; 1 of 13 spare.
